column1: # What Ferdowsi Let In: which words of the Shahnameh are Arabic.
# The forms were put forward by code (tools/candidates.py) and decided one by one by Claude, a
# language model, not by a philologist. Corrections are welcome: change the second column.
#   ar    an Arabic word: it is lit on the page and counted
#   name  a proper name of Arabic origin or Arabic shape: kept apart, not counted (as Moïnfar did)
#   no    not Arabic: a Persian word, a name of Iranian origin, or a spelling that only looks Arabic
#   - Words that reached Persian through Arabic from Greek, Aramaic or Syriac count as Arabic
#     (قلم, فیلسوف, منجنیق, قرطاس, درع): they came in by way of Arabic.
#   - Persian words that went into Arabic and came back in Arabic dress do not (تاج, دهقان, لعل).
#   - Numbers are Persian, with their Arabic-looking letters: صد and its compounds, شصت.
#   - Names are never counted, whatever their origin.
